caption: A travel chess board with magnetic pieces is tilted steeply, and the pieces stay in their squares while a coin placed on the board slides off.

sa.check: A travel chess board with chess pieces standing on its squares.
The pieces stay in their squares as the board tilts.
A coin placed on the board slides off it.
The tilt is steep: the board ends up far from level.
The coin slides while the board is tilted, not before it.

pc.expect: As the board tilts, and while it is held tilted, every piece stays on its own square, standing on the board with nothing but the board touching it.
pc.fail: Pieces slide down the board as it tilts; or topple and roll toward the lower edge; or drop off the board; or lift away from the board and hang in the air.

pc.expect: The coin slides down the slope toward the board's lower edge and drops from that edge, falling downward.
pc.fail: The coin moves up the slope; or slides off the board's upper edge; or leaves the lower edge and travels upward or stays in the air; or begins to slide and then halts part-way down with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The pieces move only with the board: none changes square, spins or hops on its own, and the board moves only while the hands tilt it.
pc.fail: A piece changes square while the board is held still; or a piece turns in place with nothing touching it; or the board tilts further or rights itself with no hand moving it.

pc.expect: The coin travels in one line down the slope, leaves the edge, lands below the board and comes to rest.
pc.fail: The coin zigzags across the slope or reverses direction before reaching the edge; or slides off and returns onto the board; or, after landing, moves back toward the board.

pc.expect: The pieces and the coin keep their number and shapes throughout; nothing sinks into the board or passes through it.
pc.fail: A piece vanishes or a new piece appears; or two pieces merge or a piece turns into a different piece; or the coin passes through the board or a piece; or the coin vanishes before reaching the table.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pieces' colours, the board's squares and the coin's face stay the same.
pc.fail: A piece changes colour; or the board's squares change pattern; or the coin changes colour or size.
